name: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – Iloilo Leg 3
short_description: A multi-distance running event held August 23, 2026, at Atria Park District, Iloilo City, Philippines, organized by Runrio.
ai_summary: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – Iloilo Leg 3 is a running event scheduled for August 23, 2026, at Atria Park District in Iloilo City, Philippines. Organized by Runrio under the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia brand, the event offers multiple distance categories including 32km, 21.1km (half-marathon), 10km, and 5km. Registration is currently open for participants interested in joining this leg of the trilogy series.

core_facts.organizer: Runrio (brand: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia)

pros: Multiple distance options (32km, 21.1km, 10km, 5km) accommodate different runner levels
Organized by an established running event brand, Runrio
research_highlights: Iloilo Leg 3 is the culminating race of the three-leg series, featuring the signature 32K 'Afroman' distance alongside 5K, 10K and 21K options.
Previous Iloilo legs (2025) were staged at Casa De Emperador, Mandurriao, Iloilo City, which has served as the race hub/start-finish area for the series.
All finishers within the cut-off time receive a finisher's medal, with age-group/gender awards for the top 3 in the 32K category for Leg 3.
Completing the 16K in Leg 1, 21K in Leg 2, and 32K in Leg 3 (in any host city) qualifies a runner for the 42K category at the National Finals in Manila.
Race rules prohibit skates, strollers or animals on course, require runners to stay within marked course boundaries, and impose a non-refundable P5,000 fee for formal result protests.

faqs.answer: This event is scheduled for August 23, 2026. It will be held at Atria Park District in Iloilo City, Philippines, and is organized by Runrio under the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia brand.

faqs.answer: Participants can choose from four distance categories: 32km, 21.1km (half-marathon), 10km, and 5km. The half-marathon distance of 21.1km is listed as the primary distance for this event, offering flexibility for runners of varying experience and fitness levels.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The race takes place at Atria Park District in Iloilo City, Philippines. This venue serves as the location for the Iloilo Leg 3 event within the broader Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 series.

faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 – Iloilo Leg 3 is currently open. Interested participants can sign up for one of the available distance categories ahead of the event date on August 23, 2026.
